description: Source code implementing SignedCertificateTimestamp and related classes for handling signed certificate timestamps, including serialization/deserialization and comparison operators.

classes.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp
classes.description: Represents a signed certificate timestamp with methods for persistence and creation from pickle.

classes.name: SignedEntryData
classes.description: Holds data related to a signed entry, with reset functionality.

classes.name: DigitallySigned
classes.description: Represents a digital signature with parameter matching method.

methods.description: Comparison operator for ordering SignedCertificateTimestamp objects.

methods.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp::Persist
methods.description: Serializes the object into a pickle.

methods.name: SignedCertificateTimestamp::CreateFromPickle
methods.description: Deserializes a SignedCertificateTimestamp object from a pickle.

methods.name: SignedEntryData::Reset
methods.description: Resets the SignedEntryData to default state.

methods.name: DigitallySigned::SignatureParametersMatch
methods.description: Checks if the signature parameters match given algorithms.
